extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the exact BZX584C2V4 row was selected from the BZX584C2V4 through BZX584C43 electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The BZX584C2V4 row gives VZ minimum 2.2 V, nominal 2.4 V, and maximum 2.6 V at IZT = 5 mA; the nominal value and paired IZT are used for the zener breakdown fields.

The exact row gives maximum ZZT = 100 ohm at IZT = 5 mA, maximum ZZK = 600 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, reverse leakage IR = 50 microA at VR = 1.0 V, and admissible IZM = 5 mA. Zener impedance, knee current, temperature coefficient, and admissible-current fields are not represented by the strict schema.

The forward-voltage maximum is 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA from the p. 1 maximum-ratings table. No component-specific capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published; the p. 3 capacitance and dynamic-impedance plots are grouped series-level characteristics without a uniquely identified BZX584C2V4 trace.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZX584C2V4 trace labeled 2.4 in p. 3 Fig. 1 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.
